# weka_lockout_policy (Resource)

The cluster account lockout policy. There is one per cluster. Destroy resets it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weka_lockout_policy" "this" {
  lockout_duration  = 120
  num_failed_logins = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lockout_duration` (Number) Seconds an account stays locked after too many failed sign-ins.
- `num_failed_logins` (Number) Failed sign-ins before an account is locked.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `cluster`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import weka_lockout_policy.this cluster
```
